comparisonRule: only compare harnesses when dataset hash, subset, model, prompt, judge, retry, tools, permissions, and receipt fields are identical

protocols.name: LongMemEval
protocols.method: official flat-bm25-compatible session retrieval plus recency baseline and oracle upper bound
protocols.boundary: retrieval evidence only; not final QA accuracy or harness quality

protocols.name: LoCoMo
protocols.boundary: official evidence-label retrieval diagnostic only; not LoCoMo official QA/F1 and not comparable with LongMemEval score

protocols.name: LongBench
protocols.boundary: task/category/model configuration must be fixed before comparison

protocols.name: RULER
protocols.boundary: synthetic stress evidence is not real workflow productivity

protocols.name: NoLiMa
protocols.boundary: not a replacement for multi-session QA evaluation

nextAction: Implement a bounded 20-question LongMemEval reader/QA protocol with the same receipt fields, then compare no-compaction versus one/multi-pass compaction.
